universe.description: low float small-cap stocks with parabolic moves on hype/news

setup.rule: Identify multi-day or multi-week parabolic move on low-float stock driven by hype or weak news
setup.quote: there's just so much hype and so much hype behind them that they're just bubble so that to me would be a golden setup

setup.rule: Look for failed bounce or breakdown after heavy volume drop
setup.quote: usually what I do again and I'm taking paper cut losses on the upside I'm starting with a starter size ... if it goes down I'm gonna add if something goes up or breaks through support I'm getting out

entry.rule: Starter short on failed bounce or breakdown, add on further downside
entry.quote: I would rather short look for a breakdown look for a failed bounce short that and I want to keep adding when I'm in the money

stop.rule: Cut immediately on break of resistance on volume
stop.quote: if it breaks if I'm short and something breaks through resistance and extend definitely if it breaks through resistance on volume I'm just gonna cut that loss

exits.rule: Hold multi-week runners into backside move; scale out on further downside
exits.quote: something that's a multi-week runner I'm gonna hold that overnight sometimes for weeks on it

sizing.rule: Starter size then add aggressively only when in profit on golden setups; size up on highest conviction parabolic moves
sizing.quote: on the short side or for me finding that one thing is a parabolic setup ... why would you not want to put as much money as you can behind that trade

market_filter.rule: Avoid earnings season; reduce activity when small caps slow
market_filter.quote: when you have you know in the midst of earnings season you just don't see small cap runners like you do ... usually just kind of chill out a little bit more

ambiguities.issue: No concrete daily-bar rules or long-side method provided
